Definition: Questions regarding late delivery, tracking number updates, courier delays, or orders marked delivered but not received.
Requests for returning an item, inquiring about refund progress, requesting replacement, or reporting damaged, broken, missing, or wrong items.
Requests to cancel an existing order or change order parameters (delivery address, delivery slot, quantity, or shipping method) before dispatch.
Issues regarding double charges, unexpected deductions, payment method failures, gift card balances, vouchers, promo codes, or invoice requests.
Inquiries or issues regarding Amazon Prime membership, annual renewal charges, Prime Video / Music streaming errors, Kindle Unlimited, or subscription cancellation.
Troubles logging in, password reset issues, two-factor authentication (OTP/2FA) failure, suspended/locked accounts, or suspected unauthorized account access.
Questions regarding stock availability, restock dates, product compatibility, technical specifications, seller authenticity, or warranty coverage.
Expressions of gratitude, generic compliments, emotional rants/frustration without specific order context, or casual greetings.
